title: Aspire Flexus Pro Replacement Pods 2ml - 2 Pods
description: Enhance your vaping pleasure with the Aspire Flexus Pro Replacement Pods, specifically designed for the astounding Flexus Pro Pod Kit. These pods come in two resistance levels: 0.6ohm for those who enjoy a more open, direct-to-lung (DTL) vape, and 1.0ohm for vapers who prefer a tighter, mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw. Each pod holds up to 2ml of your favourite e-liquid, offering a balance of flavour and vapour production with its integrated mesh coil design. The 0.6ohm pod is ideal for a smoother DTL experience, producing ample vapour, while the 1.0ohm pod caters to MTL vapers looking for a more concentrated flavour and a cigarette-like inhale. Both pods feature a convenient side-filling system, making e-liquid top-ups easy and mess-free. Packaged in twos, these replacement pods ensure you're never left without your essential vaping device. They are built with quality and precision, guaranteeing a leak-free experience thanks to their secure fit and advanced design. Compatible with a wide range of e-liquids, these pods are perfect for those who appreciate the nuances of vaping and are looking for a reliable, flavourful experience. Whether you're at home or on the go, the Aspire Flexus Pro Replacement Pods are a must-have accessory for your Flexus Pro kit, providing versatility, reliability, and quality with every puff. These pods are best used with 50/50 , Nic Salt or High PG E-Liquids Please note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
